points.description: Gives most of the expansion: at least three of Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats (any wording, minor spelling errors accepted).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only one or two of the four words are correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) if the student gives about three or all four of Strength, Weakness, Opportunity, Threat, even with spelling errors or singular/plural differences. Give 1 mark if only one or two are right. Give 0 if none are right or the answer is unrelated.
